name: Sanofi India Ltd
about: Sanofi India Limited is amongst the leading multinational companies in the Indian Pharmaceutical Market. It offers a wide array of medicines for therapy areas such as Diabetes, Cardiology, Thrombosis, Central Nervous System and Anti-histamines.[1]
keyPoints:
Parent Company[1]
Sanofi Global and its 100% subsidiary - Hoechst GmbH, are the shareholders of Sanofi India and together hold 60.40%. Company's follows parent company's financial year hence, Financial year is same as Calender Year.

pros: Company has a good return on equity (ROE) track record: 3 Years ROE 40.6%
Company has been maintaining a healthy dividend payout of 113%
cons: Stock is trading at 12.9 times its book value
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of -8.10% over past five years.
Debtor days have increased from 27.6 to 41.7 days.
